# Official curl Windows distribution

These notices are copied, without translation or modification, from the official
curl 8.21.0_7 Windows x64 package. The package's curl.exe SHA-256 exactly matches
the renamed software/curl-libressl.exe distributed with MARK.

BUILD-MANIFEST.txt gives the exact versions and original source URLs for every
component; BUILD-HASHES.txt preserves the upstream build hashes. The unused
trurl-specific notices and unrelated package binaries are not redistributed here.

The Public Suffix List source snapshot used by libpsl is provided in source/.
The exact original Mozilla certificate source URL is in BUILD-MANIFEST.txt;
SOURCE_ORIGIN.json records whether a local copy is included. Both datasets retain
the Mozilla Public License 2.0, reproduced in MPL-2.0.txt.
The original notices for curl, LibreSSL, Brotli, zlib-ng, zstd, libpsl, libssh2,
nghttp2, nghttp3, ngtcp2 and the compiler runtime are preserved under dep/.
